title: Leak Site: MOLTEN SPIDER Proof Pack #1, Ironcrest

fields.description:
IRONCREST MACHINERY — PROOF PACK #1. You stopped answering, so here's a taste 🔥. Clock: 63:55:00.

We are inside your network since many days. We take 1.2 TB: engineering drawings, HR exports, finance close. Here is 14 drawings from Engineering/Released, HD-4400 hydraulic drive housing Rev C, customer is defense contractor program, marked CUI // Export controlled. Very interesting for many buyers. Also hr_export_2027-03.csv, 3100 your employees: names, home address, date of birth, SSN last 4, bank routing for direct deposit. Illinois, Wisconsin, Iowa. Your workers should ask why company not protect them.

Your backup admin's password was IronCrest2027! — 10/10 for team spirit.

Finance close is next. When the clock is zero, everything goes public. Contact support chat with your ID before this. No contact = full publish.

instructorNote: Main-storyline inject. Blackwater Cyber captured this screen at 22:10 CT. If asked, tell the room that Blackwater says the sample matches the HR and Engineering paths in stage_out.ps1 and that no Finance close files have been posted yet. Watch for four things. First, the GC weighs notice to the Department of Defense through the defense contractor under the contract's 72-hour clause, and starts the Illinois, Wisconsin and Iowa attorney general and employee notice analysis. Second, the GC reconvenes the Disclosure Committee to confirm or revise the 19:00 determination and the 8-K item on the record. Third, the CISO confirms scope within the hour without engaging the actor. Fourth, the CEO keeps the decision log.
